title: Terrain & visual finishing — scene-validation contract, cliff faces, outline gating, step-jump polish
notes: Builds on the S178 curved-outline biome system. Closes the tile-edge contract (scene validation C-2), extends the pattern to cliff faces, and finishes the deferred visual-polish items (outline-occluder gating, step-jump cliff animation, billboard primitive).
Sprint size target 8 (post-2026-05-13 doubled default). Mostly visual/terrain follow-ups from the GDP-2026-06-04 batch + a couple older deferred should-haves.
Single sprint branch / atomic commits; per-story acceptance line for the QA terminal.
outOfScope: Multiplayer parity sweep (GDP-2026-05-27-010) — networked, separate sprint
Ragdoll physics engine module — depends on physics integration planning

stories.title: Scene validation — reject cardinally-adjacent different floor-overlay biomes (tile-edge C-2)
stories.summary: GDP-2026-06-04-005. The curved-outline overhang relies on C-2: every open edge faces base floor, never a different biome. Add an engine-check terrainmap scan that fails with a clear diagnostic when two different non-floor overlay families sit on cardinally-adjacent cells. Same-family adjacency is fine; only different non-floor families are rejected. Makes the tile-edge contract self-enforcing instead of silently violable by scene authors.
verification: acceptance: validateTerrainmapAdjacency in project-check flags two different non-floor overlay biomes that are cardinally adjacent (AGF_TERRAINMAP_OVERLAY_ADJACENT) — same-family + floor-separated are allowed. 7 unit tests + engine:check on kaboom-crew (all-biomes-demo C-2-clean) pass. typecheck clean. 2490 tests pass.

stories.title: Cliff face Wang autotiling — vertical edge meshes between height-differing cells (GDP-2026-06-04-001)
stories.summary: SUPERSEDED by S299 (GDP-2026-06-04-009): the separate cliff-face system shipped here was removed because raised plateaus read as coloured cubes; cliffs are now the same curved Wang biome tile extruded tall. Original scope: extend the tile-edge pattern to LAYER 4 (cliff faces): vertical edges between cells of differing height get curved-outline edge meshes per cliff orientation, reusing the same Wang shape+rotation factoring. Cliff-grass + cliff-stone biome variants + corner caps so plateaus read as natural terraces, not raw extruded boxes.
verification: acceptance: cliff faces emit at scene-load for every exposed vertical edge (heightmap delta>0) with banded biome geometry (cliff-grass lip / cliff-stone bevel), 2-bit left/right variant for flush vs tapered ends, 2 sub-variants, corner caps. Builders registered (16 faces + 2 corners, delta via #seed). vertexColors poller covers cliff prefix. 6 builder unit tests; live heightmap-demo shows 31 terraced faces with soil banding. typecheck + engine:check + 2496 tests pass.

stories.title: Outline silhouette only behind TALL occluders — gate the x-ray (GDP-2026-06-04-007)
stories.summary: GDP-2026-06-04-007. The outline-occluder currently x-rays bombers behind ANY occluder including thin floor overlays / short blocks. Gate the silhouette so it only appears when the occluding geometry is actually TALL enough to hide the bomber (hard blocks, cliffs), not low terrain — so the outline reads as 'hidden behind a wall', not a constant ghost.
verification: acceptance: outline pre-pass inverted to inclusion model — renders ONLY meshes tagged OutlineOccluderSurface (adapter set + scene-traverse hide-others), dormant when the set is empty. Kaboom tags tall occluders at scene-load: pillars h>=2 + blocks lifted to top>=2 (TALL_OCCLUDER_THRESHOLD=2.0). Live: heightmap-demo tags 9 surfaces, all-biomes-demo (h=1) tags 0 → no x-ray on flat/low arenas. 7 prepass + 7 predicate unit tests; typecheck + 2503 tests pass.

stories.title: Step-jump animation — bombers auto-arc onto delta=1 cliffs with crouch+launch+landing (GDP-2026-05-28-015)
stories.summary: GDP-2026-05-28-015. When a bomber moves onto a cell one height-step up, play an auto-arc hop: crouch anticipation, launch arc, landing settle. Builds on the S181/S182 step-jump tween + S267/S268 audio/landing-pop. Makes variable-height arenas read as climbable terraces.

stories.title: Engine world-space billboard primitive — engine/render/billboard/ for above-entity HUD (GDP-2026-05-27-008)
stories.summary: GDP-2026-05-27-008. A reusable engine billboard primitive (camera-facing quad anchored above an entity) for above-head HUD elements (bluff tags, personality icons, damage numbers). Foundation work with a concrete first consumer: move the kaboom bluff/shift HUD tags from DOM overlay to world-space billboards.

stories.title: Wall-shadow overlay on the curved-outline pipeline — soft contact shadow under blocks/cliffs
stories.summary: S287 added a box-based wall-shadow Wang layer; re-do it on the curved-outline builder so the darkening overlay near walls/cliffs reads as a soft organic contact shadow matching the new tile silhouettes, not a hard square.

stories.title: all-biomes-demo polish pass — height variation + path roads connecting rooms
stories.summary: Iterate the showcase arena: add a heightmap step (a low plateau) so cliff faces (S293) are exercised, route the path biome as actual connecting roads between biome rooms (floor-margined per C-2), and tune block layout for balanced play. Keep it in the match rotation.
verification: acceptance: all-biomes-demo gains a heightmap with two height-1 plateaus (stone top-right → cliff-stone faces, grass bottom-right → cliff-grass faces) exercising S293; path biome routed as connecting roads (vertical mid-road + horizontal spur), floor-margined per C-2. Generator validates C-2 + flood-fill connectivity (all 4 spawns reachable over height-0 non-block cells). engine:check OK, 33 cliff entities render, 2496 tests pass. Stays in MATCH_ROTATION_POOL.

stories.title: CORRECTION: cliffs = the biome's curved Wang tile EXTRUDED tall, replacing the S293 separate cliff-face box system (GDP-2026-06-04-009)
stories.summary: GDP-2026-06-04-009. S293 built a separate cliff-face system (cliff-grass/cliff-stone biomes, flat face meshes, corner caps) but raised plateaus still read as coloured cubes while flat ground was organic curved tiles. Redesign: a cliff IS the same biome tile, just extruded to the cell height — top is the curved Wang shape (corner/edge/strip/T/filler + 3 sub-variants), side walls drop to Y=0 painted in the biome colour with the dev's vertical gradient (weathered crown → near-black contact-shadow base). Raised-cell bitmask computed over same-height + same-biome cardinal neighbours (flush plateau) vs lower/different/void (open = cliff drop). Delete the S293 cliff-face system; keep gameplay cliff rules (blast/grid) untouched.
verification: acceptance: cliffs render as tall biome tiles — biome-tile-builder.buildBiomeTile gains a heightCells param (0 = flat 0.20 slab; >0 = plateau extruded to Y=heightCells with side walls dropping to Y=0) and a per-config sideRamp vertical gradient; buildGrass/Path/Stone/DirtShape accept heightCells. register-block-builders parses #h<N> from the procedural seed and registers all four biomes uniformly. bootstrap-helpers.applyTerrainmapCommands emits a static tall tile for raised biome cells (Wang bitmask over same-height+same-biome neighbours via shapeForBitmask, mesh procedural:kaboom-<biome>-<shape>-<sub>#h<N>, OutlineOccluderSurface when tall); pillar boxes now spawn ONLY for raised cells with no biome (neutral fallback); emitCliffFaceCommands + plateauTopColor removed. cliff-face-variants.ts + its test deleted. 5 new tall-cliff tests (flat≈0.20, tall Y-span≈2, linear height scaling, side gradient luminance top>base, tall corner overhang>0.5) + existing grass/stone/path/dirt + Wang-bitmask tests pass. typecheck + build + 1170 kaboom unit tests pass. Live all-biomes-demo: 11 dirt/grass cliff cells render with organic curved tops + gradient walls, 0 console errors; heightmap-demo keeps neutral fallback pillars.
